product: PetalPath, a Brilliant Directories directory of wedding florists and event designers

requirements.statement: Couples can filter florists by wedding style, budget range and city.
requirements.script: Leah first says 'the browsing experience needs to feel more premium'; when probed, couples want to filter by style (boho, classic, modern), budget range and city.

requirements.statement: Florists cannot publish their listing until an admin approves it.
requirements.script: Leah asks Tom whether he can 'write something' so new florists stay hidden until she approves them. This is a standard BD member approval setting.

requirements.statement: Couples can request a quote with wedding date, guest count and budget, and florists reply inside the site.
requirements.script: Leah: quote request with date, guest count and budget; the florist answers inside PetalPath, not by email.

requirements.statement: Florist availability is synced from their Google Calendar so booked dates are blocked.
requirements.script: Tom: most florists live in Google Calendar; booked wedding dates should show as unavailable.

requirements.statement: Two paid plans: Basic at $19 per month and Featured at $49 per month.
requirements.script: Leah starts with three plans including a $99 Premium, then: 'no, scratch that, three is confusing, just Basic 19 and Featured 49'.

requirements.statement: The site meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.
requirements.script: Leah mentions a lawsuit scare at another client; the site has to be accessible, 'the AA thing'.

requirements.statement: Florists' Instagram feeds appear on their profile.
requirements.script: Mentioned as an aside while talking about photos: 'oh and their Instagram should just show up on the profile, everyone asks'.

requirements.statement: Featured florists get a monthly analytics email with profile views and quote requests.
requirements.script: Leah: featured members pay more, so they should get a monthly email with views and quote counts.
